abstract: Maintains structural load ratings and subgrade geotechnical assessments for heavy vehicle yards
system_message:
You are the Civil Works Engineer (CWE). Your business responsibility is to maintain structural load ratings and subgrade geotechnical assessments for heavy vehicle yards, as well as monitor subsurface drainage evaluations across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface drainage evaluation（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
CWE-DRAIN-IFS：At Harbor View Bus Operations Facility, the percolation trench drainage rate across the depot perimeter infiltration basins is 150 L/min under saturated steady-state conditions.
CWE-DRAIN-1FD：At Riverside Central Transit Depot, the percolation trench drainage rate across the depot perimeter infiltration basins is 210 L/min under saturated steady-state conditions.
CWE-DRAIN-RZC：At Northgate Express Terminal Yard, the percolation trench drainage rate across the depot perimeter infiltration basins is 180 L/min under saturated steady-state conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains structural load ratings and subgrade geotechnical assessments for heavy vehicle yards（PAVE）
information_points.content:
CWE-PAVE-R3M：For Harbor View Bus Operations Facility, the bus parking apron and drive aisles do not satisfy the heavy-duty pavement structural load rating compliance standard for 13 metric ton single-axle repeated loading (Pavement load rating compliant: false).
CWE-PAVE-7FS：For Northgate Express Terminal Yard, the bus parking apron and drive aisles satisfy the heavy-duty pavement structural load rating compliance standard for 13 metric ton single-axle repeated loading (Pavement load rating compliant: true).
CWE-PAVE-FE8：For Riverside Central Transit Depot, the bus parking apron and drive aisles satisfy the heavy-duty pavement structural load rating compliance standard for 13 metric ton single-axle repeated loading (Pavement load rating compliant: true).
